notes.title: Thanks for the support & NEW game update
notes.notes:
I want to give a big thank you, to everyone who played and reviewed the game! It really means a lot to me, and keeps me motivated to continue creating top tier tentacle content.



On that note, I want to announce my next upcoming game: Mimic in the Dungeon. 

Featuring an upgraded tentacle tech system, lactation, impregnation, body modifications and many more features. 

You can wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3742990/Mimic_in_the_Dungeon/



Try the Gallery for yourself in this tech demo for web, pc and android:

https://pocketacegames.itch.io/tangled-by-tentacles

notes.title: New secret AREA and CHARACTER Update
notes.notes:
A new secret area has been added to the game.

Collect the 5 blue keys hidden in various levels, to unlock the new area in the Chocolate River. Eat your way through five new expert levels to gain access to the secret character; the cyborg A.D.A.

notes.title: Secret Area Update
notes.notes:
3 Keys has been hidden in various levels. Collect them all to unlock the gate near Boss Fight # 1.

Conquer 7 new challenging levels to unlock the Elven character "Elora", complete with outfits and gallery scene.

notes.title: Full release
notes.notes:
The base game is now out of early access with version 1.0

All levels, boss fights and endgame highscore levels. 3 different poses for lewd scenes, as well as lots of unlockable equipment: Tentacle wraps, Gag ball (with muffled sound effects), Tentacle suction drainers 

I plan on adding more content in the future as free updates. Secret areas with new levels, 3 new characters and more unlockable equipment (such as rope, harness and options for dicks instead of tentacles)
